title: InfinityOS _02: a cleaner tray and more reliable updates
summary: Quick Settings gains compact, centered app icons, InfinityUpdater stays on the top bar, and cancelling installation preserves the available update list.

changes.title: App icons in Quick Settings
changes.text: Tray apps now sit below the system controls and volume sliders, between neutral separators. Compact, equal-sized cells keep a small group of icons centered with consistent spacing, without a three-dot button.

changes.title: Keep important apps on the top bar
changes.text: Right-click an app icon to move it to the top bar or back into Quick Settings, or hide it. Preferences persist across sessions, with localized actions. Hidden apps can be restored from the tray area's context menu.

changes.title: InfinityUpdater stays within reach
changes.text: The updater icon stays in the top bar even when no updates are available. Only its count badge disappears at zero, and saved app-tray hiding preferences do not affect it.

changes.title: Cancelled installation keeps the update list
changes.text: If every installation command fails, including when authorization is cancelled, InfinityUpdater keeps the saved list and reports the error instead of replacing it through an automatic follow-up check. Successful or partly successful installations still check what remains, and existing restart notifications are preserved.

changes.title: Stable tray behavior
changes.text: Unchanged icons stay attached during synchronization, avoiding unnecessary layout work and menu closures. Reloading the extension preserves icon order, including pinned apps and apps that start later.

changes.title: Tested desktop changes
changes.text: Regression checks cover tray spacing, centering, icon size, app menus, saved preferences, locking, late arrivals, update authorization failures and restart notifications. The release also passes native GNOME 51 and GTK checks.

title: InfinityOS _02: a sharper clock and a seamless terminal handle
summary: Desktop polish keeps the clock and terminal handle centered, matches the handle to the panel and gives the lock-screen prompt room to breathe.

changes.title: A sharp, steady clock
changes.text: The clock stays centered when opening and closing InfinityTerminal or when the time label changes width. Pixel-aligned positioning keeps the text sharp, and the terminal icon no longer takes space in the centered panel layout.

changes.title: A handle that matches the panel
changes.text: The pull handle samples the visible panel background and periodically checks its position. Maximized windows now reliably trigger the compact handle, even when a theme leaves a small gap below the panel.

changes.title: A balanced lock screen
changes.text: The classic Sonoma-style lock screen centers the avatar and password prompt as a group and reserves space below the large clock to prevent overlap.

changes.title: A clearer dock edge
changes.text: A brighter top border adds one pixel of definition to the adaptive dock in both light and dark modes, while custom borders keep their settings.

title: InfinityOS _02: the pull-down terminal lands in fresh ISOs
summary: Verified ARM64 and x64 images now include the adaptive InfinityTerminal handle, more flexible resizing and improved dock behavior in live sessions.

changes.title: Pull down to open
changes.text: A symmetrical handle below the clock opens InfinityTerminal with a click or a downward drag. The terminal follows the pointer, keeps the chosen height on release and receives keyboard focus. Short pulls close it again, while Escape cancels the gesture.

changes.title: A handle that adapts
changes.text: The centered handle animates to half size when the terminal is open or a window reaches the panel beneath it. It supports light and dark themes and respects reduced motion. Overview and the lock screen hide the controls; fullscreen retains GNOME's panel visibility behavior.

changes.title: More room to resize
changes.text: The terminal can now be resized below half the screen, down to a 96-pixel minimum. Dragging its lower edge back to the top panel hides it.

changes.title: A more responsive dock
changes.text: Window overlap detection now works in live sessions and ignores minimized windows. The dock respects fullscreen visibility in the live desktop, and adaptive backgrounds gain a subtle top border matched to the active theme.

changes.title: Verified images and release cleanup
changes.text: Both architecture builds passed verification and uploaded their ISO artifacts. The R2 publication job also completed successfully. Release cleanup now waits six minutes after promoting the new pair before removing older versioned files, allowing the website cache to refresh.

title: InfinityOS _02: pull down, get to work.
summary: InfinityTerminal gains a centered pull-down handle, smoother manual resizing and a cleaner fit with the desktop in light and dark modes.

changes.title: A new way to open InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Click the symmetrical handle below the clock or drag it down to reveal the terminal. Release it at the height you want, or drag its lower edge back to the top panel to hide it.

changes.title: Out of the way when you need it
changes.text: The handle smoothly shrinks to half size when the terminal is open or a window reaches the top panel, including maximized windows. It returns to full size when the space is clear. Fullscreen keeps GNOME’s normal panel visibility; Overview and the lock screen hide the activators.

changes.title: Aligned and refined
changes.text: The handle stays centered independently of panel layout changes. Its hamburger sits slightly higher, and the panel outline joins the curved handle. Both light and dark themes are supported, with a subtle matching highlight along the adaptive dock’s top edge. The dock moves out of the way when a window touches its area, including in the live session.

changes.title: Checked before release
changes.text: Regression tests cover click and drag behavior, cancellation, resizing, visibility and centering. Native GNOME checks also exercise the handle and theme switching. New ISO downloads and checksums appear only after both architecture builds pass verification and finish publishing.

title: InfinityOS _02: a smoother desktop and fresh downloads
summary: The latest 24 hours brought new ARM64 and x64 images, direct downloads, a more capable terminal, simpler setup and fixes across gaming, NVIDIA installation and system updates.

changes.title: Fresh ARM64 and x64 images
changes.text: Both Fedora 45 and GNOME 51 live images were built and verified from the same source revision. Downloads now open the ISO directly from Cloudflare R2; filenames, sizes and MD5 and SHA-256 checksums on the website come from the verified release manifest. Future successful builds replace the published pair automatically.

changes.title: NVIDIA prepared before first boot
changes.text: On supported x64 NVIDIA hardware, installation now builds and checks the driver modules, rebuilds the boot image and updates the rEFInd copy before finishing. A failed driver setup stops installation instead of leaving the problem for the first desktop session. Network access is required.

changes.title: Steam starts reliably on desktop and TV
changes.text: Desktop Steam and TV Mode now use the working runtime launcher. TV session startup, exit behavior and installation defaults were corrected. Steam remains closed after TV Mode setup so its first update can finish from the desktop.

changes.title: A simpler first run
changes.text: InfinitySetup opens on the System tab with a centered loading message. Its search spans categories, while InfinityConfig drops its unnecessary search bar. Setup and Config retain their app icons, dock favorites appear in the app grid, and several changes applied together need only one administrator authentication.

changes.title: A more useful InfinityTerminal
changes.text: Configurable widgets add available CPU and GPU readings, timers, Pomodoro, network transfer, battery, weather and a second time zone. Monitors can be moved and are centered in the terminal. The drop-down animation now enters fully from above the screen, and its panel icon follows the active theme.

changes.title: A smoother InfinityUpdater
changes.text: The update drawer opens with a softer motion and keeps its actions readable in light and dark themes. Downloaded offline updates now trigger a notification with a localized restart action. Restart handling and update completion messages were also corrected.

changes.title: Desktop details and extensions
changes.text: Desktop icons and dock artwork are more compact, mounted-drive icons match the InfinityOS palette, and NowPlay and Raccoon Launcher are bundled. Animation fixes and native GNOME extension checks improve reliability, including with reduced motion enabled.

changes.title: News from the live desktop
changes.text: Firefox in the live installer opens this changelog, making the latest build notes available before installation.
